comments.text: Watching this on a Saturday night from Phu Tho, Vietnam! 🇻🇳 As a documentary video editor, I am so impressed by how the script aligns with the visuals. In image_3c079f.jpg, showing the dense, beautiful architecture of the towns while the voiceover discusses how they were told they were too small to matter on "their own" [15:03] is a great editorial setup for the segment on their massive global inventions. To answer your question [15:27]: The empty beauty of the Highlands is stunning, but learning about the Highland Clearances—where 100,000 people were violently pushed out just for sheep [13:50]—makes that emptiness feel deeply tragic. It shouldn't be empty. Incredible storytelling! 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿🎥
